row.title: A closing probe that greps its own issue file proves nothing
row.body: Session: session_0156nqDte8FeqRLjvGRAAb6w. foundation/ideas.py brainstorm filed Q-SPIN-* scope items with probe grep:docs/issues/<id>.json::Status:** closed, which passes as soon as the item is marked closed; four were closed that way with no work done. Fix (PROBE-REAL-1): every scope template in doctrine/spinoff-ideas.json carries a probe on code, ideas.scope_probe refuses a missing probe or one under docs/issues/, the four falsely closed items were reopened on their real probes, and Q-35/38/48/50 were re-probed on code (QNFO fleet inventory doctrine/qnfo-fleet.json read from the Cloudflare API, checked by sauce.fleet_check). Test: tests/foundation/test_ideas.py, tests/foundation/test_sauce.py.
